issues.author: mock
issues.title: Login form drops session on refresh
issues.body: Repro: log in, hit reload — you land back on /login. The session cookie is set correctly, but the client store rehydrates before the cookie check resolves, so the auth guard redirects.

prs.author: mock
prs.title: Fix flaky auth test in CI
prs.body: Loosens the timing assertion in refresh.test.ts to a realistic budget.
